remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks confused this painting with another titled *Red & Orange Hills* that O'Keeffe destroyed. See Appendix II, no. 111. Dated 1938 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Oil on canvas; Orange and Red hills overall with tree near the top of the proper right side. Some cream and greenish on ground.
